name: MMD benchmark dataset
description: A large-scale multimodal, domain-aware conversation dataset with over 150K conversation sessions in the retail fashion domain. It supports five new sub-tasks for multimodal conversations, including text response generation and best image response selection, with detailed per-state evaluation.
reputation: A specialized multimodal retail-fashion conversation dataset that is mainly used in academic research rather than broad community leaderboards.
notes: Dataset created with domain experts and annotators; enables focused research on dialog states in multimodal conversations.
